item.title: As Xi Visits Washington, Trump Plays Down China’s Actions Against U.S. Interests
item.description: Despite the rivalry between the United States and China, President Trump has repeatedly found ways to give President Xi Jinping of China a pass, portraying him more as a personal friend than a competitor.
item.dc:creator: Erica L. Green
item.media:description: President Trump has spent weeks dismissing or excusing reports of China’s infractions as he’s prepared for the “great honor” of hosting President Xi Jinping in Washington.

item.title: Where Is the U.S. Beating China on A.I., and Where Is It Lagging?
item.description: As Xi Jinping visits President Trump in Washington, his country lags behind the United States on A.I. development in key areas — but Beijing has advantages elsewhere.
item.dc:creator: Dustin Volz and Cade Metz
item.media:description: The World Artificial Intelligence Conference in Shanghai in July. China and the United States are locked in an A.I. race that both sides see as decisive to gaining the upper hand militarily, technologically and economically.

item.title: As Trump Welcomes Xi, More Americans Have a Positive View of China
item.description: Experts attribute the changing mood to fading memories of the coronavirus pandemic, awareness of China’s tech innovations and disaffection with President Trump’s trade wars.
item.dc:creator: Anton Troianovski

item.title: America’s A.I. Leaders Warn U.N. of Possible Peril Absent a Global Response
item.description: Sam Altman of OpenAI and Dario Amodei of Anthropic told the Security Council that international cooperation was needed to ensure that A.I. remains under human control.

item.title: Fox News Finds Itself at Odds With Trump on Press Ban

item.title: Iowa Judge Dismisses Trump’s Lawsuit Against The Des Moines Register
item.description: The suit challenged a poll that showed Trump trailing Kamala Harris in the final weeks of the 2024 campaign. A judge warned that similar legal challenges could have a chilling effect on news reporting.
item.dc:creator: Ishani Desai
item.media:description: A poll published by The Des Moines Register in 2024 showed Donald J. Trump trailing Kamala Harris in Iowa. Mr. Trump went on to win the state by double digits.
